title: UpdateShellPreferencesRequest
description: Body of PATCH /api/users/me/preferences (HEL-1574, HEL-1572): any non-empty subset of the shell keys (contextListWidth, contextListCollapsed) and appearance keys (typeStyle, density, motion); unknown fields and out-of-range/unknown values are rejected with 400. Only the fields present are stored. `motion: null` removes the saved motion choice so the user follows the OS reduce-motion setting again.
